Metrics.Name: intune.config_assignment_status.assignments
Metrics.Description: Intune configuration-policy assignments counted by report status and policy platform. Each device x policy assignment row is bucketed into Microsoft's ReportStatus x UnifiedPolicyPlatformType enum space (both bounded); the per-row detail — which device, which policy, which user — is on the intune.config_assignment_status log twin, never a metric label.
